payload.core_mechanism_summary: O(n) scan counting good subarrays; checks local triples (last 3) and quadruples (last 4) for 'good' condition: middle element not between outer two. Good arrays have max length 4.
payload.rationale: Solution leverages mathematical observation that any subarray of length ≥5 is bad. Counts length-1,2 directly; for each new element, checks if length-3 and length-4 subarrays ending there are good. No explicit greedy choice or exchange, but the ruling algorithm type is greedy_exchange_argument.
